**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 00:53
- [FACT] The user is starting a new AI/ML consulting business.
- [FACT] The user has solid experience in product management, product design, and web development.
- [FACT] The user has recent but significant familiarity with developing machine-learning based tools and automations.
- [PREFERENCE] The user prefers to engage and build a remote team of developers, product managers, and designers as needed.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is looking for team members who have technical and communication skills that cross all three disciplines and can work directly with clients.
- [EVENT] The user is considering reaching out to local businesses directly, through events, or other methods to gauge interest in their services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested considering additional criteria for selecting a target market, including level of competition, market size and growth potential, customer pain points, customer demographics, and cost of customer acquisition.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided 10 unconventional pricing options, including performance-based pricing, equity-based pricing, partnership-based pricing, referral-based pricing, auction-based pricing, reverse-auction-based pricing, risk-sharing pricing, usage-based pricing, bundle-based pricing, and charity-based pricing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided 20 ideas for how the user could start talking to their target market, including attending industry conferences, publishing blog posts, using social media, hosting webinars, creating a website, offering free consultations, using email marketing, joining industry groups, attending local business networking events, partnering with complementary businesses, using Google AdWords, offering a referral program, creating case studies, using influencer marketing, attending trade shows, creating a podcast, using direct mail, using video marketing, offering free trials, and using targeted advertising.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested that the user should start by focusing on services that leverage their existing skills and determine which services to expand into as demand grows.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended building a remote team, hiring on an as-needed basis, using subcontractors, developing clear processes and systems, investing in ongoing training and development, and maintaining a strong focus on client satisfaction as the user builds out their team structure.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created a structured plan for the user to consider when building out their team structure and executing work, including focusing on existing skills, determining service expansion, building a remote team, hiring as needed, using subcontractors, developing processes, investing in training, and focusing on client satisfaction.
